content.title: National Weather Service
content.text: This AfternoonA 50 percent chance of snow. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 34. East southeast wind around 9 mph. Total daytime snow accumulation of less than one inch possible. TonightRain and snow likely before midnight, then snow. Steady temperature around 31. East wind 9 to 18 mph. Chance of precipitation is 80%. New snow accumulation of 1 to 2 inches possible. ThursdaySnow. High near 32. East northeast wind around 18 mph. Chance of precipitation is 80%. New snow accumulation of 1 to 3 inches possible. Thursday NightSnow likely, mainly between 7pm and 1am. Cloudy, with a low around 26. North northeast wind 11 to 15 mph. Chance of precipitation is 60%.FridaySnow, mainly after 1pm. High near 32. Northeast wind 14 to 16 mph. Chance of precipitation is 80%.Friday NightSnow. Low around 29. North wind 14 to 18 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%.SaturdaySnow likely, mainly before 1pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 34. Breezy, with a north northwest wind 21 to 26 mph. Chance of precipitation is 70%.Saturday NightPartly cloudy, with a low around 21. Blustery, with a west northwest wind 14 to 21 mph. SundayMostly sunny, with a high near 39. West wind 14 to 18 mph. Sunday NightMostly cloudy, with a low around 25. Northwest wind around 16 mph. MondayA 20 percent chance of snow. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 33. North wind 14 to 17 mph. Monday NightMostly cloudy, with a low around 15. North northeast wind 9 to 13 mph becoming east after midnight. TuesdayPartly sunny, with a high near 36. Breezy, with a south southeast wind 13 to 21 mph. Tuesday NightMostly cloudy, with a low around 29. Breezy, with a south wind around 20 mph. WednesdayA slight chance of rain and snow. Partly sunny, with a high near 45. Breezy, with a south wind 20 to 23 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%.
